node.title: L1 Mersenne HNF m=8 order-one quadratic-collision router
node.statement: For a quadratic colored Frobenius interpolant on the six reduced h=7 roots, two repeated colors force an even interpolant and exactly two antipodal repeated pairs. This chamber also satisfies r(18+d-d^2)+192=0 for d=c-1 and r=rho*c. The complete quadratic residue splits into collision-free, one-repeat, and this two-antipodal chamber.
node.notes: Exact degree-two router, not an emptiness theorem. The two-antipodal chamber has one additional scalar equation; collision-free and one-repeat chambers remain independent.
